mission: Find all TODO comments and technical debt in IHIM/

debt_patterns: Bare exception handlers: Multiple functions use 'except Exception' without logging (utils.py lines 45, 58, 99, 127, 141, 154, 167, 181)
Hard-coded platform path: workspace root path hard-coded for Windows (C:/Users/<user>/workspace) in utils.py line 15
Incomplete error handling: Browser operations return True/False but callers don't know what failed (utils.py lines 145-154)
Silent failures: run_command_background suppresses all output to DEVNULL, makes debugging difficult (utils.py line 124-125)
Inconsistent string quoting: Mixed use of subprocess.Popen with string vs list arguments (utils.py lines 80, 149)
Shell injection risk: Uses shell=True in subprocess calls (utils.py lines 80, 149)
No validation: Action handler doesn't validate action_id exists before dispatch (registry.py line 107-175)
Magic strings: Status messages and success indicators are repeated rather than centralized (registry.py multiple locations)

debt_patterns.description: except Exception: pass patterns that silently ignore errors, making debugging difficult
Redundant try-except blocks for optional modules (FEEDBACK, SANITY, SYSTEM_HEALTH, SLASH_COMMANDS, TEAM_BUILDER, TERMINAL) - could be consolidated into a single import helper
Allowing all origins for CORS is a security risk - should be restricted to specific domains
Multiple boolean flags (FEEDBACK_AVAILABLE, SANITY_AVAILABLE, etc.) for conditional module loading - should use dependency injection
Broad except clauses with pass statements (Exception, OSError, Exception) that hide errors and make debugging hard
Multiple conditional platform checks (sys.platform == 'win32') scattered through code - could be abstracted into platform manager
Silent exception handlers in check_blackboard() and check_data_team_state() prevent proper error logging
Broad exception handling in parse_command_markdown() and load_command_center_data() - should be more specific about what errors are acceptable
CommandStatus.DEPRECATED defined but may need cleanup logic to handle deprecated commands

recommendations: Implement a proper exception handling strategy - avoid bare except clauses
Restrict CORS origins to specific domains (CRITICAL SECURITY ISSUE)
Consolidate optional module imports into a single loader with proper logging
Refactor platform-specific code into a platform abstraction layer
Add proper error logging instead of silent pass statements
Consider implementing dependency injection for optional features
Review and clean up deprecated command handling logic

debt_patterns.description: 39 test functions marked with @pytest.mark.skip('Flight Path feature not yet implemented')
debt_patterns.impact: Feature coverage incomplete - entire Flight Path visualization feature waiting implementation
debt_patterns.note: Tests written as specifications/requirements (test-driven approach), but feature not yet implemented

debt_patterns.description: 8 test functions using @pytest.mark.skipif for platform-specific tests (Windows/Unix)
debt_patterns.impact: Cross-platform testing requires running full suite on multiple platforms

debt_patterns.description: High reliance on unittest.mock (MagicMock, patch decorators) throughout test suite
debt_patterns.impact: Tests may not catch integration bugs; subprocess spawning and process communication heavily mocked
debt_patterns.note: Test spawner explicitly documents that spawn_single_agent and spawn_agent_team are mocked due to spawning real Windows Terminal processes

debt_patterns.description: Line 750 contains: 'pass  # Acknowledged: jitter makes exact testing difficult'
debt_patterns.impact: Test acknowledges timing issues in stopwatch/jitter testing but doesn't implement robust assertions
debt_patterns.note: Known limitation documented but not addressed - test vacuously passes

debt_patterns.description: Multiple print() statements used for console output in test functions (slash_commands/)
debt_patterns.impact: Test functions include stdout debugging instead of proper logging; makes parsing pytest output difficult
debt_patterns.note: Lines 45, 50, 276-331 in test_command_structure.py and lines 30, 35, 39, 238-278 in test_command_content.py

debt_patterns.description: Numerous assertions using 'assert result is True' and 'assert result is False'
debt_patterns.impact: Style issue - idiomatic Python would use 'assert result' and 'assert not result'
debt_patterns.note: Widespread pattern indicating opportunity for test code cleanup

findings.summary: Tests directory has 39 skipped tests (Flight Path feature), 8 conditional platform tests, heavy mock usage throughout, some untested timing issues, debug print statements in commands tests, and non-idiomatic boolean assertions.
